name: Protects
description: A ruleset gates a repository, or a specific ref within it. One ruleset defined at the organization protects many repositories, so this is the edge that carries application while the ruleset node carries definition. (Ref target: the neutral git_core__git_ref since github-core#76.)

ref_pattern.description: The condition token or fnmatch pattern that selected the target (`~DEFAULT_BRANCH`, `refs/heads/release/*`). Preserved as written.

match_kind.description: `declared` — the ruleset applies to the repository and its pattern is recorded verbatim. `resolved` — the pattern was matched against a ref actually observed on the grid. A view that shows what protects `main` today wants resolved; an audit of intent wants declared.
